description: Classify what a visitor or their AI wants from taskbullet.com (hire a VA, apply for a job, existing client, Agent API, or a phone call) and return the next URL. Job seekers are never hire conversions. A phone-wall agent uses place_call and the calls wallet (POST /api/v1/accounts, pay-as-you-go). New accounts receive a $20 trial grant (10 hours). Do not spend those hours on the call.

message.description: What the visitor said or asked. Capped at 2000 characters.

pageUrl.description: Optional page they are on. Capped at 500 characters.

name: match_intent
